in_vitro_detail: cAMP production measured in HEK-293 cells transfected with pcDNA3.1-GLP-1R_tango; % activity normalised to 10-7 M GLP1_C and EC50 fitted in OriginPro.

agents.name: GLP1_16HSA
agents.sequence_source: Figure 3A caption states 'The amino acid sequence of sfGFP-GLP1_C' but no one-letter sequence is printed in the body. Body describes the variant as GLP-1 with K34R and A8G mutations and p-azido-l-phenylalanine (AzF) replacing valine 16, conjugated to HSA via DBCO-PEG4-MAL and SPAAC.
agents.chemical_identifier: intact mass 70,653.7 m/z by MALDI-TOF MS (expected 70,606.8)
agents.group_n_quote: The mice were randomly divided into three groups (n = 5) and were weighed before injection.
agents.dose_route_quote: GLP1_HSA variants (10 nmol/kg dose) were intravenously administrated to each group of mice.
agents.pk_quote: The half-lives of GLP1_16HSA, GLP1_19HSA, and GLP1_28HSA were 8.4, 7.4, and 8.0 h, respectively. The body calls these 'half-lives' and 'serum half-lives' with no phase label, no two-phase fit and no rate constant, so half_life_phase is 'unspecified' and neither an absorption nor an elimination half-life is asserted. Blood was sampled at 0.16, 1, 2, 4, 8, 12 and 24 h. In vitro EC50 = 0.70 microM.

agents.name: GLP1_C (recombinant/synthetic GLP-1 variant, K34R + A8G)
agents.sequence_source: Body states the mutations (arginine at position 34 replacing lysine; alanine 8 mutated to glycine) but prints no one-letter sequence.
agents.chemical_identifier: monoisotopic mass 3382.7 m/z; The GLP1_C peptide was synthesized by GenScript (Piscataway, NJ, USA)
agents.group_n_quote: The mice were randomly divided into five groups (n = 6).
agents.dose_route_quote: GLP1_C (100 nmol/kg dose), each of the GLP1_HSA variants (100 nmol/kg dose), or saline was subcutaneously administrated 1 h before glucose injection.
agents.pk_quote: Such a poor glucose-lowering effect of GLP1_C can be attributed to its short half-life. No PK study was run on GLP1_C; the 'wild-type GLP-1 (3 min)' figure used for comparison is a literature value, not a measurement made here. In vitro EC50 = 1.4 nM.

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: Pharmacokinetic profiles of the GLP1_HSA variants in mice. Each data point in the graph represents the mean ± SD (n = 5).
concentration_time_figure.note: Serum concentration versus time after a single 10 nmol/kg i.v. dose; the caption states 'The logarithmic serum concentrations over time were plotted to produce a linear fit', i.e. a mono-exponential fit consistent with the single unlabelled half-life reported.

bioanalytical_method: Sandwich ELISA targeting both HSA and GLP-1 (polyclonal anti-albumin rabbit capture, monoclonal anti-GLP-1 mouse detection, anti-mouse IgG-HRP, A450)
bioanalytical_quote: The serum concentration at each time-point was measured by a sandwich ELISA targeting both HSA and GLP-1 (Figure 6).
notes: Only a single half-life value is reported per conjugate, with no phase label, no two-phase model and no rate constant anywhere in the body, so half_life_phase is 'unspecified' and half_life_absorption/half_life_elimination are both 'not reported'. No Cmax, tmax or concentration-time AUC is reported anywhere in the body - the AUC in Figure 7B is a blood-glucose AUC from the IPGTT, not a PK exposure metric, and was deliberately not recorded as PK AUC. Comparative half-lives quoted in Results 3.3 (8.5 h for chemically synthesised GLP-1-HSA in mice; 1.7 or 12.1 h for PEG-GLP-1 in rat; 3 min for wild-type GLP-1) are explicitly attributed to previous studies and were not extracted as this paper's data; rat is therefore not listed in in_vivo_species. Sequences: the Figure 3A caption refers to 'The amino acid sequence of sfGFP-GLP1_C' but no one-letter sequence is printed in the body text; the long sequences in the PEPLIFE2 header are database metadata and were not used. The body does describe the variants in words: GLP1_C carries K34R and A8G, and AzF is site-specifically incorporated at V16, Y19 or F28 with HSA conjugated via DBCO-PEG4-MAL and strain-promoted azide-alkyne cycloaddition. Curation rule applied: the intraperitoneal glucose challenge (1.5 g/kg) is a procedural probe and is documented here rather than listed as an agent; unconjugated HSA, DBCO-PEG4-carboxyrhodamine and Factor Xa are preparation/characterisation reagents that were not administered. Serum ELISA is bioanalysis of in vivo samples and was not classified as an ex vivo study type.
